scoring_justification: Full recompute of tight‑binding energies is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; scoring uses a result‑level compare of the reported ΔE values against the paper's gold with ±10 meV tolerance plus a structural ordering check.

outputs.description: The four pair-energy differences for hydrogen atoms at tetrahedral interstitial sites in bcc iron, computed as ΔE(T3,T_i) for i=1..4.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported values to the paper-reported reference values with an absolute tolerance and verify the relative ordering ΔE(1) > ΔE(2) > ΔE(4) > ΔE(3)=0.

steps.description: Check each neighbor's delta_E_meV is within ±10 meV of the paper's reported values.
Verify relative ordering ΔE(1) > ΔE(2) > ΔE(4) > ΔE(3).
